description: A non-anchored key_pattern governs by prefix, not by an interior match.
descriptor: { descriptor_version: "1.0", root: { type: "object", children: { o: { type: "object", key_pattern: "worker", additional_children: { type: "int" } } } } }

divergence.note: Report A25 is the baseline answering which keys an object governs differently in different places. The validator governs the key with re.search, so key_pattern "worker" accepts the key "xworker", while node_at and the resolver use a prefix match and refuse it. The Dart implementation uses one prefix predicate everywhere, so an object never governs a key its own node lookup rejects.
